description: Searches patients within an organization/branch by name (patient_identifiers/MRN search is not covered by this contract - see notes).

query_parameters.query: string, required - matched against first_name / last_name

validation: search is organization + branch scoped; matches first_name or last_name (ILIKE)
notes: database/api_contracts_test/010_patient_management.sql also searches by patient_code ILIKE, but as noted in API-016's contract, patient_code does not exist as a column on patients in the current schema. This contract limits the searchable field set to first_name and last_name, which do exist. Searching by an MRN/identifier value would need to query patient_identifiers instead, which is not yet part of a contracted endpoint.
